This summary uses an explicit First/Second/Third/Fourth/Last sequence to connect eight observed layout types, simulation measurements, a PCA appraisal, then two optimization refinements and condition-dependent adaptation. Its distinction is the output handoff: simulation supplies the appraisal indices; appraisal identifies a trapezoid baseline; the two optimization models then target dimensions/tollbooth count and merging pattern. Safety is represented here by the number of merging points, which is an author-selected proxy rather than evidence of measured collision rates. The closing feasibility claim is qualitative. Office-use labels and Summary Sheet furniture contaminate the opening, and repeated discretionary word wraps remain in the prose. No source-boundary, model, formula or figure acceptance.
